paragraphs.text: Though he was both hungry and in great distress, yet he made God above all meat and drink.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: In this misery I exercise myself in the contemplation of your power and glory, as if I were in the sanctuary.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: I have seen thee in the

paragraphs.text: The remembrance of your favour is more sweet to me than all the pleasures and dainties of the world.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He assures himself by the Spirit of God to have the gift of constancy.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: He prophecies of the destruction of Saul and they who take his part, whose bodies will not be buried but be devoured with wild beasts.
paragraphs.label: f
paragraphs.anchor: They shall fall by the sword

paragraphs.text: All who swear by God correctly or profess him will rejoice in this worthy king.
